prior_result: The earlier channel_feature_gate_job58693851 was invalid for held-out evaluation because train/test channel seeds overlapped 499/500. Its neural-only-count and cold first-call gates also failed. This is a new calibration with entirely fresh, disjoint seeds and explicit feature prewarm; it does not relabel the earlier result.
research_question: On the synthetic fixed pre-fading-noise Rayleigh workload, can a prewarmed observable channel-power threshold selected on fresh training channels skip at least 10% of NeuralRx calls on held-out channels while losing at most 1% of neural-only successes?
role: Qualify a possible strong-baseline input only; never count as joint-policy novelty or real-time PHY evidence.

feature.name: channel_estimate_power
feature.prewarm: one observed_channel_features call during receiver startup, before the first timed channel trial
feature.selection: maximize training NeuralRx skips with at most 2/500 neural-only correct TBs lost; keep the threshold unchanged on test

scope_change_from_prior: The earlier requirement of at least 50 neural-only cases is reported descriptively rather than used as a gate. Baseline qualification here concerns the skip/loss decision on this workload; a small neural-only denominator will limit any radio-utility claim. This choice was fixed before the new trace and must be disclosed with the earlier failed gate.
interpretation_limits: Prewarmed feature GPU time excludes startup; its host-to-decision latency still requires online measurement. No MPS co-run, actual MAC expiry, or external TDL channel is tested. Passing observed skip/loss gates does not establish a worst-case radio-utility guarantee.
